features.title: Physical Ballistics
features.description: Projectile travel, drop, penetration and destructible interactions.

features.title: Caliber-Based Damage
features.description: Damage is based on ammunition and protection instead of weapon level.

features.title: Injury & Medical Systems
features.description: Wounds need treatment and can affect you after the fight ends.

features.title: Radiation Overhaul
features.description: Radiation and environmental exposure have lasting consequences.

features.title: Dangerous Weather
features.description: Storms and weather can force you to change how and when you travel.

features.title: Expanded Quests & Locations
features.description: New quests, enemies, companions, locations and worldspaces.

features.title: Unified Crafting
features.description: Crafting is organized around dedicated benches and consistent recipes.

features.title: Ammunition Production
features.description: Break down ammunition and manufacture the rounds you need.

features.title: Pip-Boy Power
features.description: Pip-Boy use has battery, heat and wear systems.

features.title: Performance & Stability
features.description: Crash fixes, load-time work and curated performance settings.

features.title: Automated Installation
features.description: The supported setup is installed through Wabbajack.
